source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I am Alex M., I am 23 years old. I'm an electrical and electronics engineering student in Istanbul, I'm in my 3rd year, I'm constantly busy with computers. I've been playing computer games since I was a kid.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: My favorite type of game is games that are connected with reality. Games that bring reality to the forefront.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: You know the latest game released, Escape from Tarkov, it’s the most realistic game on the market right now. I think it's a very realistic and well-made game. I realized that the games that I have played so far are not games

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: At first, I started with console games, play station 1, 2, 3, 4. I was playing Fps games with story generally, then I focused more on the computer, then I started with Fps games, then I played Moba games, and the calmness of MOBA games started to feel boring. Afterwards, I met with Survival games, and when I realized that there are games where I can think and apply something, the games started to be very enjoyable for me. I didn't have much time to play anyway. The excitement of doing a quick loot gave me pleasure, and it still gives me pleasure.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I prefer RPG more for a long time. Role play gaming has more variety, but I think there should be a shooter in the game. We players like to see how the guns shoot, how we should and how they move with different attachments. There is a market in the game and we shop at this market and we us gamers, we love these kinds of things.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, I've played all kinds.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Like every Turkish kid, CS go was my first game. Then I started playing Wolf team, then I continued with Cs go, I started playing Owerwatch, then I started playing Valorant recently, now I play occasionally to relieve stress. Apart from these, I also play Tarkov and Hunt style games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I just came to my city, I reset my computer, the first game I will install is Escape from Tarkov. I was putting the map to one side and playing the game, it felt so real. Since I want to play at least one fps game, I play Valorant. Since the price is affordable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I can say I am constantly seeking a duel, I like to play directly in the chaos, in games like this, which is the main topic of the meeting, people should not be messed with, but we definitely do. I'm trying to go into battle using my aiming skills because when I don't, I'm no better than a shepherd. Constantly collecting and bringing things...

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, I am a very competitive person.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: As a former Lol player, I think the rank system is what makes a game enjoyable. When there is no rank system in a game, the game becomes unplayable after a certain point. The rank system can raise a game very high. If we think about Valorant, you are in the eyes of people at high ranks. When I think about it, I realize that the rank system is useful.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Shooter games from my childhood, that's why I still play Valorant right now. At the moment, details such as realism, bullets, running speeds attract me more. Now I like to strategize. The strategy in Valorant now remains simple. But I like strategies such as what should we do, where will the enemy come from.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I trust my aiming skills, I usually try to do aim training. I usually try to analyze the game I play and learn from other players. Except for computer performance, of course. I usually think about how I can improve myself, and it is very enjoyable to achieve development.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I've been playing a lot for a while, there were aiming devices, I was playing with it. If I'm playing a game, I try to play it as best I can. I was playing Pubgm.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, because after a certain time, my fingers would go numb. I was using them because these devices allow us to play more comfortably. Mobile games started to feel like I was doing the same thing to me after a while. I felt like there was no improvement. So I quit mobile games and started computer games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: First of all, I learn from places that share such news on Instagram, and at the same time, my friends research the games and have information and tell me. Just because a game is advertised well doesn't mean it's good, so they're constantly doing research. That's why we try the games first, then we talk about the games and start playing the games. We are already discussing the questions you are asking me and analyzing the games among ourselves.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: There are too many ads in front of us on Google, sometimes games appear on game platforms such as Steam, and we search and examine them. If we want to play fps games, we search for that genre and sometimes we find games using foreign sources. After all, the gaming market is something that covers the entire world.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: The most important aspects for me are the gun calibrations, the way the guns are fired and the realism of the way the guns are used. Even in the most realistic Fps game, there is a synchronization problem, let's say I had a conflict with someone. What appears on my screen and what appears on his screen are different from each other. No matter how realistic they make the game, such a problem happens. I want the games I play to have that synchronization. Like most FPS players, I play games with low graphics to focus on the details of the conflict. For me, the absence of the synchronization problem I just mentioned keeps the game ahead of the others for me. The map of the game is also very important to me, and what I can do on this map is also very important to me. For example, there are games that do not have map information. We explore the map ourselves, we learn where and what it is, and I think this is a very enjoyable thing. There can be more than one map in fps games, some maps are liked while others are not. All things considered, synchronization is more important to me than anything else.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Reducing the detailing reduces the perception of reality of the game, yes, but I increase the clarity of the events by reducing the details there. The visuals don't need to be overly realistic, by realism I mean the realism of the way the game is played.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I think Tarkov is a very realistic game that has left its mark on the game world. The game really has a lot of options. As I said before, I open the map and think about something and play the game. A market has been added to the game, I am trading in the market. Tasks are very nice tasks bring the game to a very good place. The only thing I don't like about Tarkov is that people have respect for each other, you will understand what I mean when I talk about other games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I learned the game by chance, at first I was very prejudiced. I had thoughts about the realism of the game. One day a friend of mine told me the game and the game was in its own platform. As you know, it is very brave to publish a game on its own platform without advertising in known platforms. I tried the game and started playing it. I met the game thanks to a friend of mine. At first we had doubts about whether the game would be worth the price we paid. Right now the game helps me a lot to clear my head.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Tarkov is a game that uses the survival element in Pubg and contains realism. At the same time, it does not compromise on Fps. Characters have features such as thirst and cold. I'm not just shooting, this game provides me other features. I find the game very original I hope the bug I just mentioned will be fixed too.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: A game in RPG+Fps style. It is both an RPG and an FPS game. I think this game genre should have a name of its own, it should be a nice name that rhymes, like MMORPG.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: It can be nabbed as Reality Fps.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Loot lost when dead is too simple.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I know the game, yes. I played.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I know Cycle but I haven’t played it. Maraduers, Vigor, Zero Sievert, I don’t know them. I know Dark and Darker but haven't played it. I never played Hell is Others. I liked the DMZ and played it for a while. Battlefield, I played it. It started very well, but I couldn't get what I wanted. In mobile I played Badlanders on computer on Steam. Since this game didn't give me what I wanted compared to the others, I didn't focus on it much.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: All Task based games. There is an instructive part at first, for the players. There are Tiers in Dmz, and there are Boss tasks in Hunt. These games are usually games about doing tasks on the map. Apart from these, PVP is open in all of them, we can fight with other players, we can be a team. There can be players who respect and leave without starting a war. This leaves the competitiveness to the player's discretion but some of them have a war environment. For example, in Hunt, we were constantly fighting with a team. Compared to the others, I was more duel-oriented in Hunt. Let's say I'm playing games at night, I'm sleepy, if I come across someone in Tarkov, I may not be war-oriented, but I will definitely fight in Hunt.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: At the moment, I like the Tarkov-style games more. Because doing tasks, looting and not being sure whether I will die while carrying loot makes the game very enjoyable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: As I mentioned, the game realism and the detail of the tasks are very good. I haven't seen any game tasks that are bad so far. There are even tasks designed to teach beginners the game. The tasks are not very easy and not as complicated as MMORPG. The weapons in the game are also very important to me, the weapons in these games are very well made. In some games, the characters are more prominent, but if I have to speak for the games where the weapons are in the foreground, the guns are very realistic in terms of caliber and firing in general.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: These two games were in the foreground because they were the first, but as the number of games in this style increased, they fell into the background and I was sad about it, I loved the role play parts of the Arma. I think, compared to the other games, Tarkov provides the Life in game that players want. However, I don't think the game is played in the long run.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Because of the synchronization problem I mentioned, I expect the conflict I saw on my screen to be the same as what the other person sees on the screen, and we think it should be fixed. No matter how realistic the game is, if the optimization and synchronization are not done properly, the players are alienated from the game. The system of the game is very nice, but nothing goes smoothly, it's not stable, it's like we're playing by complaining a little. So I think it won't be played much in the long run. I've seen a lot of games that started well this way but weren't interested by the developers afterwards.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. With the proliferation of Bitcoin and similar things in the pandemic, the fact that it has its own system in the game also contributes to the game, I think. We look at the gun market, we look at our options, it is very good that there is a special market in game, the game is very unique in this sense.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: These games require some mental control, you know you can get very angry when you die suddenly after all that effort. Too many of my friends, after they died, got up from the computer and went to the corner and sat quietly, nervously. Some of them expect the game to be very flawless and when they see any problem, they decide not to play until this problem is fixed. But I also have friends who ignore certain things and continue to play because they like change.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I have a group of 10 friends, if I have to rate it over this, 3 of them started very eagerly and then quit the game, All 3 people got angry with the mistakes of these games and left the game because they couldn't handle it. We continue as a team of 4 people.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I always start out with low expectations when I play games like this. If I start with high expectations, I may be disappointed.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I started at first because I was wondering what exactly the game makers trust in making this game on their own platform without a global popular one. How could they be so self-confident by saying this is the most realistic FPS game, I wondered that too. Not everyone's computer, as you know, is suitable for every game, at first I thought they would appeal to a small audience. I wondered what was going on, is there anything given to the players contrary to what they were told, what they were giving the players. Some games start to feel like children's game after a point, Hunt started to make me feel like I'm playing a child game after a point. In Tarkov, I realized that it was a little more than that. The game changed my style of play, I started playing more strategic and loot oriented instead of war oriented.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, it took me a long time to get used to the game. It was very difficult to get used to, I can still say that we play at medium level, not at very high level. In the game, I come across people playing like soldiers who play as if they were born for this game. Afterwards, I started to wonder if even I was playing this game thinking about something in stress, how were these people I met playing this game? I always wonder who is at the top level of a game that is the reason I follow foreign streamers on twitch.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: My game time for Tarkov is over a hundred hours.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I usually play calmly and on weekends, except during exams. In general, this game genre has a style that you start to distract yourself, but then you don't stop playing because it draws you in. After a while you become addicted to strategy and it gives you a lot of fun and pleasure.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: On average, I play 5-6 hours on Saturdays and 3-4 hours on Sundays, but of course, sometimes I play longer.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I have a team that I have played with since I was a kid and we play together every time, if any of the team members are not available, we do not play that day. Maybe it's because I'm used to it, but in a game the team is always very important. I expect to have a settled team especially in games like this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: A score above 8 means an average game in my opinion, the reason why I gave half a point less is the synchronization problem I mentioned. The reason I gave 2 points less is that I think no game is good enough to get 10 points, even in 2023, I don't think there is such a good game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Because after a certain time, the game started to get boring to me. Besides, since there is a War-oriented game, I even had a fight with strangers on discord servers. We were playing as a team, by communicating, but the war-oriented game started to tire me after a while. While playing games, it is necessary to disconnect from the world. A round takes between 30-35 minutes on average. I feel like 3 hours have passed after the round is over and it was making me tired, That's why I prefer games that don't tire me anymore.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I gave half a point less because it is a game that tires the computer so my teammates cannot play it. I played the game with one of my friends using his account, the game's system, tasks, the colors of the weapons are very nice. At first, it explains the game with simple tasks, I already know COD since I was a kid. I liked Call of Duty because even with its story-based game logic, I am very familiar with game. I liked the game because it is a classic Call of Duty game, but I started to dislike it because it had some optimization problems.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. In the long run, the game pushes the computer very hard, which causes Fps Drop. It reduces the motivation of the player to play the game, because we play as a team, so the game does not appeal to us.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: This game was given to me as a gift when I bought my computer.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: This game was the last game I started with high expectations, after this game I learned that I should keep my expectations low. At that time, I had just bought my computer, and I started the game with great hopes, but I was very sad afterwards. I thought I could get used to such a game layout, but then I saw that there was no order in the game, the optimization was bad, and the game was a messy game. Even the tasks ere bad. I started playing the game because the game was advertised very well, I thought the game might be nice but it's not. There are very bad comments on Reddit about the game, it became free after that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: It's a more kill oriented game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: When we entered the map, we started to feel like we were walking around the neighborhood, we find something from somewhere with my friends, my other friends remind me of different places. The game makes me feel like I'm in the game with VR glasses and I'm really running around. Other games can't give me such a realism feel. As you know, it doesn't have a very complicated map, it has a map where the locations of the exits are simplified, and this makes me feel like I'm really in the game and I know the places.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: In the game, my inventory of weapons in the character is detailed, the game is more than just injury and healing. The game is like seeing Arma for the first time. The game also shows that realism can be done without the need for high graphics.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I think these are nice features, but if it is in every game, it gets boring after a point. Very nice realistic graphics can be made and the game can look very nice, but these features must be suitable for the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. It is not a game that everyone can do, but good games can be made without these features.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: My priority is to create a strategy and play games on that strategy.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: When I started playing, this map looked very difficult to learn, I felt like I couldn't do it. I was playing the game wrong at first, even if I had very little loot, I was constantly trying to attack players. Then I started playing more strategically by finding a base, looting and moving more carefully from one place to another. Of course, I didn't do this by seeing people, I determined my own strategy and over time, I realized that this game the way I play. Now, I get rewards for these strategies by developing better strategies in the game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: The fun part is that I play these games with my friends and they get immersed in the game like me. As I explained before, I don't feel like I'm playing a game using only the keyboard and mouse, I really feel like I'm in the game.  This is the part that really makes the difference.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Shooter games are usually focused on killing. Then, games about shooting and surviving started to appear. Afterwards, they designed a game in which you can survive with the items in your hand and get out of it. I want to be equal to the people across from me on the map, I don't want it to be pay to win.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: If I give Valorant as an example, it is clear where the bullet will go when we aim, but there are no situations such as aiming and shooting according to the running direction of the man. Because it's not that realistic. In games such as Pubg and Tarkov, it is necessary to aim to the side where the man is running because the speed and duration of the bullet are also important in the game. It's nice to feel even the slightest change we've made on the gun.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, perfect guns feel like water guns in games that don't have this feature. Especially with the colorful skins on the guns, the guns seem like toys to me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: My goal is to do better in Tarkov's unique market. For this, I am trying to create the necessary solid capital without paying any money. I wonder how will I dominate the map I landed with high loot and quality items. When I reach this goal, I think the game will stabilize for me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I used to play the game as caveman at first, now I play silently as a sniper. If someone from the outside sees me, they think I'm crazy, but now I play closer to the screen and more carefully. Sometimes, when I meet someone in the game, I want to attack the player immediately, then I remember that the game is not suitable for this and calm down.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Sometimes when I come across very good players I feel like the time we spent looting in the game is wasted. When I realize that the other person is playing much better than me, I think what did I miss because he plays better than me. I'm wondering where I made a mistake. As I told you, my goal is to loot strategically, but when I can’t achieve this goal, I'm wondering reason for it.  Sometimes I have the synchronization problem that I told you about. At such times, I think this problem should be fixed. Sometimes there are bugs in games.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, when all the mistakes I've said come together, I feel like I'm just sitting in front of the screen and clicking the mouse, like I'm not in the game. A game made realistically but if there are so many mistakes, I think, it doesn't matter if the game is this realistic. For example, if there is a problem on the map, I cannot develop a strategy, I can't plan either, first of all the gameplay needs to be good.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: In fact, this is a pleasant situation, encountering really good players in the game is an indication that you are playing the game very well. I want to congratulate my opponent for playing so well and then I realize that I can play that well too. It doesn't make sense to compete with anyone, there are players who dominate the game market after all. The player has completely brought his weapons to the highest level, plays the game very well, and can heal himself while fighting. When I look at the player, I can see that the man entered there not to collect loot, but to dominate the game. I am waiting for the time when I will reach that stage.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: First of all, the game map is very easy. No matter how difficult the map is for some people, after playing for a while, you realize that the map is a simple map. Some games have really difficult maps. I've been playing for a very long time I haven't had any FPS problems. The game only has the synchronization problem I told you about. I don't just play the game, I become the character in the game. I remember that I shouldn't run too much. I get hungry, I get thirsty. That's the difference with other games. Gaming doesn't just mean FPS. Thanks to this game, I understood that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: The game focused on killing opponents at first, then surviving. As the circle began to shrink, people had to learn what they could do on a small map, where they would go and hide. This caused the players to set up a strategy such as heading towards the direction where the circle narrowed. I used to play a lot of PUBG, but now when people say let's play PUBG, I tell people I don't want to play and the game is like a child's game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. It's also a PVPVE game, but it's a kid's game now. There is also boosting the characters, but after a point I feel like I'm just using a mouse. Character stitches up in Tarkov, when I do stuff like this I feel like I'm doing something real. Nowadays, I see that games have developed quite a lot. Games are more advanced than killing now, and I think it's a good thing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Are you asking if shooting is at the forefront?

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Shooting isn't very prominent in the game itself, but I think a player's ability to aim should be at the forefront. The game doesn't need to be about %100 shooting skills, it's enough for players to have aiming skills. The game needs to explain this to players with tasks etc. The player needs to learn this from the tasks so that he can enter the fights more planned.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I like this. Bring out loot from raids gives the game a purpose.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. In fact, this interestingness gives us a certain purpose. We wonder what the players are doing in other parts of the map while we loot, sometimes we want to raid. We're considering whether to start raiding or looting. This makes the game interesting, I don't want to set a bomb anywhere by pressing any button in a game anymore, I want to do more strategy.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. As I said, I didn't expect much from this game at first and I wasn't very familiar with such game. At the moment, I don't know everything about the game. But now if i start another game like this, i can know what to do in the game. I can quickly skip the part describing the first game. Now that I have the knowledge to understand the features of the game, I can analyze the game in that way and I start ahead of the beginners.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: When I started I was thinking if the game was worth the money I paid. Of course, every game is expensive in Turkey's economic conditions. I was wondering if I would get my money's worth.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Because of my habits from Hunt, I tried to attack and loot in the game at first. But even the bots in the game were very challenging. I'm starting to think I'm doing it wrong since I can't even kill a bot. When we watched the streamers who played the game very well, we realized that we were playing the game wrong. Afterwards, we realized that we enjoyed the game when we played it strategically and systematically rather than conflict-oriented.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: The world of the game is so convenient that it is even possible to open a large server and role play between players. There can be conflicts during this role play. In game I met someone and I feel like I'm actually waving to that guy. Although they come from the same place as other games, there are now huge differences with other games. A person who really likes to play games is already caught up in this.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: For example, you have 3 minutes in FPS and you have to set up a bomb. It is not possible for us to improvise or do anything different. But in this game, you can loot if you want, you can attack someone if you want. If you want, you can sit in a corner and wait. If you want, you can explore the map. Sometimes I entered the game not to loot, but just to explore and memorize the map. At this point, the game offers us the opportunity to do what we want. The game made me think that, now I can do whatever I want in a game. Now I feel like I control the game instead of the game controlling me.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: For example, we have a friend who is on a map mission and he just goes and explores the maps. Now it seems like the man is also exploring maps in real life. My friend marks the places on the map and gives code names, he says we should communicate with each other using these code names. For example, I'm looking at the build and updates of weapons. My other friend is examining how far we can hear the voices of the opponents. Things like this are very important in games like this. When you figure these kind of things, the game becomes very enjoyable.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: When I first played this game, I couldn't kill in Valorant, I got used to aim in the direction the man was going. You can really feel the gun shooting in this game. This game attracts me more because I am interested in weapons and I know how the attachments attached to the weapons affect the weapons in real life. In Valorant, very simple weapons are like water guns, you aim and the bullet goes. It would be better if they turned to this kind of realism instead of skins animations brought to weapons.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes. PVPVE games are more competitive in my opinion. Yes, maybe the number of players is low, but bots are put in the game so that players can play all the time, and I have seen bots that can play well. Yes, we realize that the person in front of us is a bot, but they are not bots as we used to in other games. We used to find a cheat to beat bots in games I played before, but I respect even bots in this game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Long-term development and loots. If you started playing a game at a certain level, the game should make you feel it. We shouldn't be getting the initial feel when you update a weapon. Since the game makes me feel this, I put loot and strategy in the foreground. I want something from the game, the game gives me something in return and we meet at a common point. Before, games were not like this, the game was giving me something and I was trying to adapt to it. PVPVE games provided that.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, I love fantasy elements.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: Yes, I think it would be very nice. You know, there was no skill in FPS games, there was only bomb. This turned into characters with skills over time. Now it's turned into a Soldier-style dynamic conflict. It would be great if a fantasy element is added to it.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: For example, I would like to have technological devices and be able to use them, or I would like to have a character in the game and have roles, such as a healer and a pioneer. It would be nice to have a character on the map who can tell me where there are good loot. I would like a duelist character who protects us. I think such an update to the game would be nice.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: It would be nice i think i would even try to update the wizard's wand. It doesn't necessarily have to be a weapon. Such a change would be nice and would get people to play the game. Anyway, not all games are the same anymore, if there is no such change, it would be really original.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I'm telling you based on the games I've played so far, the player shouldn't be able to see the map layout when they enter the game. I want this to be a mystery. Character development in the game should not be too difficult, but when the character develops, the player should be able to feel it. The player should be able to feel something while shooting in the battles in the game. After all, this is a PVPVE game. The combat needs to be good in the game and the conflicts need to feel realistic. In the game, players look at the cost of the weapons they have won and turn it into a trade and I think that's a very good thing too. For me, it should be in the ideal game. Likewise, in my ideal game, having a wizard character, and wizard character bandaging their wounds or stitching themselves can be good too. In my ideal game, I expect the game to be different and the shooting to be good. Everyone designs unique games, today's technology is suitable for this, in most games I think the conflict part is missing.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: For example, not being able to see the effect of an addition I made to the weapon. For example, I know how the gun will have recoil when firing, or I know where to aim with the sniper, but not feeling these things is a huge deficiency. When everything is done so well, the lack of these in a game turns me off from the game. If they can get the game's aiming system right, they might even be able to bring a wizard into the game from now on.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I think it is appropriate. A skin can sometimes change the aiming ability of the weapon and you realize that that weapon is a very good weapon with that skin. Compared to the default skin, players can choose a weapon suitable for the color of the environment. For example, when I was playing DMZ, I would prefer bright colors to see the weapon. I think this is very important and I am not against the existence of skins in a game.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: You can make money by investing in a skin, developing it and selling it. This is a way of investment. But the main investment is setting up a good loot system in this game. Investing in a character and bringing it to a good level pays off more than others.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: This can happen in the game, but it should not be possible to get ahead by buying something. In the game, it can be pay to skip, but not pay to win. If we compare Turkish and foreign players, pay to win may be good for foreign players, but it is a very bad situation for us. There should definitely be a purchasing system in the game, but this purchase should not be for winning.

source_file: 搜打撤品类研究_海外_深访笔录-D2-英文原版
text: I think I am lucky with these. I am not against this situation I think that every game should have a trade I think that this trade should not be just for making money there should be an element of luck as well. It's nice to add an element of luck to the game or to think that the players are feeling lucky and buy something. This makes players think that they can not only gain something by looting but also gain something in other ways, and I think that gives a different perspective.
